title: Learn to code for kids
summary: Teach kids to code through games.
whyTempting: Parents believe coding is a key future skill.
whyItFails: Free alternatives. Scratch and free resources are excellent. Parents are the buyer. Hard to sell kids' fun to paying parents. Engagement drops. Kids lose interest.
whatWouldChange: Shifting from 'coding' to AI-building skills, sold to schools.

attempts.notes: Raspberry Pi computer kits for kids; assets sold to a company connected to its CEO.

attempts.outcome: Shut down, then relaunched as uLesson Coding School

reasons.detail: Free alternatives: Scratch and free resources are excellent.
Parents are the buyer: Hard to sell kids' fun to paying parents.
